title: Implement config.json load/validate with documented settings precedence
description: Per ADR 0004. Load <root>/config.json (non-secret keys: defaultCampaignId, profiles, doltHome, doltBin). Apply precedence: CLI flag > env var > config.json > built-in default. Reject a config file containing an API-key-shaped value so a pasted secret fails loud. Provider credentials are never read from or written to config.json (ADR 0002).
close_reason: Implemented and merged in PR #40 (ADR 0004 managed storage model).
